en.text: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 我的弟兄们，不要多人作师傅，因为晓得我们要受更重的判断。

zhTraditional.text: 我的弟兄們，不要多人作師傅，因為曉得我們要受更重的判斷。

en.text: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

zhSimplified.text: 原来我们在许多事上都有过失；若有人在话语上没有过失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。

zhTraditional.text: 原來我們在許多事上都有過失；若有人在話語上沒有過失，他就是完全人，也能勒住自己的全身。

en.text: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

zhSimplified.text: 我们若把嚼环放在马嘴里，叫它顺服，就能调动它的全身。

zhTraditional.text: 我們若把嚼環放在馬嘴裏，叫牠順服，就能調動牠的全身。

en.text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

footnotes.text: 3:4 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，船只虽然甚大，又被大风催逼，只用小小的舵，就随着掌舵的意思转动。

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，船隻雖然甚大，又被大風催逼，只用小小的舵，就隨着掌舵的意思轉動。

en.text: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

zhSimplified.text: 这样，舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，舌頭在百體裏也是最小的，卻能說大話。

en.text: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

zhSimplified.text: 舌头就是火，在我们百体中，舌头是个罪恶的世界，能污秽全身，也能把生命的轮子点起来，并且是从地狱里点着的。

zhTraditional.text: 舌頭就是火，在我們百體中，舌頭是個罪惡的世界，能污穢全身，也能把生命的輪子點起來，並且是從地獄裏點着的。

en.text: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

zhSimplified.text: 各类的走兽、飞禽、昆虫、水族，本来都可以制伏，也已经被人制伏了；

zhTraditional.text: 各類的走獸、飛禽、昆蟲、水族，本來都可以制伏，也已經被人制伏了；

en.text: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独舌头没有人能制伏，是不止息的恶物，满了害死人的毒气。

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨舌頭沒有人能制伏，是不止息的惡物，滿了害死人的毒氣。

en.text: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

zhSimplified.text: 我们用舌头颂赞那为主、为父的，又用舌头咒诅那照着 神形象被造的人。

zhTraditional.text: 我們用舌頭頌讚那為主、為父的，又用舌頭咒詛那照着上帝形像被造的人。

en.text: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

zhSimplified.text: 颂赞和咒诅从一个口里出来！我的弟兄们，这是不应当的！

zhTraditional.text: 頌讚和咒詛從一個口裏出來！我的弟兄們，這是不應當的！

en.text: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

zhSimplified.text: 泉源从一个眼里能发出甜苦两样的水吗？

zhTraditional.text: 泉源從一個眼裏能發出甜苦兩樣的水嗎？

en.text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

zhSimplified.text: 我的弟兄们，无花果树能生橄榄吗？葡萄树能结无花果吗？咸水里也不能发出甜水来。

zhTraditional.text: 我的弟兄們，無花果樹能生橄欖嗎？葡萄樹能結無花果嗎？鹹水裏也不能發出甜水來。

en.text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 你们中间谁是有智慧有见识的呢？他就当在智慧的温柔上显出他的善行来。

zhTraditional.text: 你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。

en.text: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

zhSimplified.text: 你们心里若怀着苦毒的嫉妒和纷争，就不可自夸，也不可说谎话抵挡真道。

zhTraditional.text: 你們心裏若懷着苦毒的嫉妒和紛爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。

en.text: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

zhSimplified.text: 这样的智慧不是从上头来的，乃是属地的，属情欲的，属鬼魔的。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。

en.text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

zhSimplified.text: 在何处有嫉妒、纷争，就在何处有扰乱和各样的坏事。

zhTraditional.text: 在何處有嫉妒、紛爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。

en.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独从上头来的智慧，先是清洁，后是和平，温良柔顺，满有怜悯，多结善果，没有偏见，没有假冒。

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。

en.text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

zhSimplified.text: 并且使人和平的，是用和平所栽种的义果。

zhTraditional.text: 並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
